description: A circular wooden clock puzzle with colorful number blocks sits on a blue bedspread in front of a large pillow. The left hand steadies the puzzle on the bed while the right hand grips the edge, lifts it up and tilts it over; the right hand briefly flips it face-down against the bed and then lifts and rotates it back so the blocks spill out onto the bed, before lowering the puzzle down again with blocks scattered nearby.
